//: Gzipped ceilings for every published bundle, in bytes. Read by scripts/check-size.mjs in CI. Raising a number is a deliberate edit with a reason in the commit message, not silent drift. The core ceiling is set so the documented '~10kb' stays true: 10400 bytes is 10.2KB, which rounds to 10; past 10751 the claim needs rewording, not just a bigger budget. Raised from 9600 (under '~9kb') when error diagnostics landed and crossed that line on its own. Headroom is a few percent by design — enough that ordinary work does not trip it, tight enough that a real feature is a conversation.
//devtools: The devtools ceiling is looser than the others on purpose. This bundle is development-only and never loads in production, so its bytes cost a visitor nothing — and the panel's usability is the entire reason it exists. Raised from 5600 to 6000 when docking landed, from 6000 to 6500 when state search and a collapsible scope tree landed, and from 6500 to 6800 for per-mode resize handles, to leave room for the panel to keep improving rather than making every UI change a budget negotiation.
